newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - April 16.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - April 16.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Wednesday:
* On Tuesday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average surged 135 points or 2.1 percent to 6587.16, its second biggest point rise in history.

* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index reversed early gains on Tuesday to close down 14.42 points or 1.31 percent to 1,086.67 on foreign selling. Dow gain may boost sentiment, although analysts are eyeing the 1080 and 1050 levels.
* Ringgit quoted at 2.5095/5105 a dollar at around 0830 GMT on Tuesday.

* After being awash in negative sentiment, "I think there's little to push it down further," said Ralph Dixon, of TA Securities' international division. "Local funds will probably start mopping up some stocks."
* February industrial production index up 9.1 percent from year ago, but down 6.3 percent from January.
* Consumer price index report for March may be released today.
* Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange, responding to market rumours, says it has not suspended any stockbrokers and that none has defaulted in payments to its clearing house.
* Rubber glove maker Rubberex Corp (M) Bhd set to list with offer of 4.631 million shares at 2.25 ringgit a share.
